Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.repository.messaging

Interface KfeMessageInboxRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<KfeMessageInboxEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeMessageInboxEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<KfeMessageInboxEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<KfeMessageInboxEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<KfeMessageInboxEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<KfeMessageInboxEntity>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<KfeMessageInboxEntity,UUID>
@Repository public interface KfeMessageInboxRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeMessageInboxEntity,UUID>
Coordinates durable message deduplication, consumer claims, completion, retry, and quarantine.

Bulk state transitions compare the current processing status and claim token. A row count of zero means the caller's lease is stale or the message no longer satisfies the transition precondition; successful transitions clear ownership metadata so another worker can proceed.

    • findDue

      @Query("select i from KfeMessageInboxEntity i\nwhere (i.status in :statuses and (i.nextAttemptAt is null or i.nextAttemptAt <= :now))\n or (i.status = \'PROCESSING\' and (i.claimedUntil is null or i.claimedUntil <= :now))\norder by i.createdAt asc, i.id asc\n") List<KfeMessageInboxEntity> findDue(@Param("statuses") Collection<String> statuses, @Param("now") Instant now, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Loads due messages and expired processing leases in deterministic creation order.

      now - current instant used to test retry and lease deadlines
      pageable - batch window for the consumer poll
      Returns:

    • claim

      @Modifying(clearAutomatically=true, flushAutomatically=true) @Query("update KfeMessageInboxEntity i\nset i.status = \'PROCESSING\', i.claimedBy = :worker,\n i.claimedUntil = :until, i.claimToken = :token,\n i.attempts = i.attempts + 1\nwhere i.id = :id\n and ((i.status in :statuses and (i.nextAttemptAt is null or i.nextAttemptAt <= :now))\n or (i.status = \'PROCESSING\' and (i.claimedUntil is null or i.claimedUntil <= :now)))\n") int claim(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("statuses") Collection<String> statuses, @Param("now") Instant now, @Param("worker") String worker, @Param("token") UUID token, @Param("until") Instant until)
      Atomically claims a due or abandoned message and increments its attempt count.
      Parameters:
      id - inbox row UUID to claim
      statuses - states eligible for processing
      now - current instant for due and expired-lease checks
      worker - worker identity taking ownership
      token - fresh token required for acknowledgement or retry
      until - lease expiry instant assigned to the claim
      Returns:
      one if claimed successfully, otherwise zero when another worker won

    • complete

      @Modifying(clearAutomatically=true, flushAutomatically=true) @Query("update KfeMessageInboxEntity i\nset i.status = \'PROCESSED\', i.processedAt = :now,\n i.claimedBy = null, i.claimedUntil = null, i.claimToken = null\nwhere i.id = :id and i.status = \'PROCESSING\' and i.claimToken = :token\n") int complete(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("token") UUID token, @Param("now") Instant now)
      Marks a processing message complete only for the worker holding its current token.
      Parameters:
      id - inbox row UUID to complete
      token - token issued to the active claim owner
      now - absolute instant at which processing completed
      Returns:
      one when completion was accepted, otherwise zero for a stale or inactive claim

      @Modifying(clearAutomatically=true, flushAutomatically=true) @Query("update KfeMessageInboxEntity i\nset i.status = \'PENDING\', i.nextAttemptAt = :next,\n i.claimedBy = null, i.claimedUntil = null, i.claimToken = null,\n i.quarantineReason = :reason\nwhere i.id = :id and i.status = \'PROCESSING\' and i.claimToken = :token\n") int retry(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("token") UUID token, @Param("next") Instant next, @Param("reason") String reason)
